questions.stem: Which of the following correctly completes this sentence? Rayma left home early ___ caught a bus to the city.

questions.stem: Which of the following correctly completes this sentence? The teacher took the whistle ___ my brother.

questions.stem: Which words correctly complete this sentence? Choose two options. “Jack ___ when you turn your back!” said the red-faced boy to the teacher.
In which sentences are the apostrophes used correctly? Choose two options.
options: I’ve done some good work on the project, haven’t I?
I won’t join the band unless you’re brother joins as well.
I can’t believe what’s happening to the local creek.
The dog took it’s bone but couldn’t finish eating it all?
Who’s clothes haven’t been put away in the wardrobe?

questions.stem: Click on the word that is a proper noun in this sentence. “I have a new friend,” stated Harry at dinner.
Which sentence is not correctly completed by the word while?
options: I had a rest ____ you played.
We decided to travel ____ the night.
He was gone only a short ____.
Listening to music was a way to ____ away the hours.

questions.stem: Tick the box to complete each sentence correctly. (a) Dee comes from a place far ____ the river. (b) She arrived ____ boat. (c) She came ____ Thursday.

options: The referee explained that “The goal was not allowed.”
The referee explained that the goal was not allowed.
The referee explained “that the goal was not allowed.”
The referee explained, “That the goal was not allowed.”
